QF.id: IV Fixed Income Instruments and Bond Markets_45

question.text: SEBI mandates disclosure of at least one credit rating while issuing a debt instrument. The highest quality rating grade is:

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI regulates rating agencies, issuers must obtain ratings, and SEBI mandates disclosure of at least one credit rating while issuing debt instruments. AAA represents the highest degree of safety. The Trap: AA+ is very safe but is not the highest grade; A and BBB+ are lower on the scale. Note: The disclosure requirement applies at the time of issuing the debt instrument, per the workbook.
